question: Under the Delta-BHC Study provision, does the permit establish an enforceable numeric effluent limit for delta-BHC against which reported measurements must be compared, or does it impose only plan-submission, sampling, and DMR-attachment obligations without a stated numeric compliance limit?
semantic_arguments: Target span requiring submission of a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water intake
Adjacent text requiring post-approval quarterly sample collection during permit years 2–5 and attachment of study results to DMR reports
Absence of any numeric effluent limit or compliance threshold for delta-BHC in the Delta-BHC Study paragraph
notes: Different readings change whether Purpose A performs limit-exceedance comparisons for delta-BHC, whether Purpose B classifies delta-BHC obligations as numeric-limit monitoring versus report-only study requirements, and whether Purpose C treats missing delta-BHC results as absent numeric data versus a non-numeric reporting pathway.
